_doc: Skills cloned from GitHub. Each source is cloned (shallow, sparse when 'paths' is set) into brain/skills/.sources/ at start-up and pulled once a day. Skills listed under 'active' join the harness with the header given here; every other SKILL.md in the source is 'stored': out of the index and the prompt, loadable by exact name with load_skill. 'claude_code': true also links the skill into ~/.claude/skills so Claude Code can use it without this harness. See brain/skills/sources.py. Skills Claude Code already has from a plugin (anthropic-skills: docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx, skill-creator) are not linked again.
